## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Added/updated tests where it makes sense
- [ ] DB schema changed? Generated a migration (`pnpm db:generate`)
- [ ] New env vars added to `.env.example`
- [ ] Added a changeset if a package's public behaviour changed (`pnpm changeset`)
